import json
import base64
import os
import urllib.request
import websocket

OUT_DIR = "/home/user/Documents/Blog"
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

tabs = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen("http://localhost:1337/json/list").read())
pages = [t for t in tabs if t.get("type") == "page" and t.get("url", "").startswith("http")]

for tab in pages:
    raw_title = tab["title"]
    # Strip the trailing "| Lil'Log" or similar site suffix
    title = raw_title.split("|")[0].strip()
    # Decode HTML entities just in case
    import html
    title = html.unescape(title)
    # Sanitize filename
    safe = "".join(c for c in title if c not in '/\\:*?"<>|').strip() or "page"
    out_path = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, safe + ".pdf")

    ws_url = tab["webSocketDebuggerUrl"]
    print(f"Printing: {title}")
    print(f"  URL: {tab['url']}")
    print(f"  -> {out_path}")

    ws = websocket.create_connection(ws_url, timeout=120)
    msg_id = 0

    def send(method, params=None):
        global msg_id
        msg_id += 1
        ws.send(json.dumps({"id": msg_id, "method": method, "params": params or {}}))
        while True:
            resp = json.loads(ws.recv())
            if resp.get("id") == msg_id:
                return resp

    resp = send("Page.printToPDF", {
        "printBackground": True,
        "preferCSSPageSize": True,
    })
    ws.close()

    if "result" not in resp:
        print(f"  ERROR: {resp}")
        continue

    data = base64.b64decode(resp["result"]["data"])
    with open(out_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(data)
    print(f"  OK ({len(data)} bytes)")

print("Done.")

import json
import html
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile

OUT_DIR = "/home/user/Documents/Blog"
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

with open("/tmp/tabs.json") as f:
    tabs = json.load(f)

pages = [t for t in tabs if t.get("type") == "page" and t.get("url", "").startswith("http")]

for tab in pages:
    title = html.unescape(tab["title"]).split("|")[0].strip()
    safe = "".join(c for c in title if c not in '/\\:*?"<>|').strip() or "page"
    out_path = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, safe + ".pdf")

    print(f"Printing: {title}")
    print(f"  URL: {tab['url']}")
    print(f"  -> {out_path}")

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as profile:
        cmd = [
            "google-chrome",
            "--headless=new",
            "--disable-gpu",
            "--no-sandbox",
            f"--user-data-dir={profile}",
            "--no-pdf-header-footer",
            "--virtual-time-budget=20000",
            f"--print-to-pdf={out_path}",
            tab["url"],
        ]
        env = os.environ.copy()
        # Allow proxy for the actual page fetch (the page is on the public internet)
        result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180, env=env)

    if os.path.exists(out_path) and os.path.getsize(out_path) > 0:
        print(f"  OK ({os.path.getsize(out_path)} bytes)")
    else:
        print(f"  FAILED")
        print("  stdout:", result.stdout[-500:])
        print("  stderr:", result.stderr[-500:])

print("Done.")

import json
import base64
import os
import urllib.request
import websocket

OUT_DIR = "/home/user/Documents/Blog"
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

with open("/tmp/tabs.json") as f:
    tabs = json.load(f)
pages = [t for t in tabs if t.get("type") == "page" and t.get("url", "").startswith("http")]

for tab in pages:
    raw_title = tab["title"]
    # Strip the trailing "| Lil'Log" or similar site suffix
    title = raw_title.split("|")[0].strip()
    # Decode HTML entities just in case
    import html
    title = html.unescape(title)
    # Sanitize filename
    safe = "".join(c for c in title if c not in '/\\:*?"<>|').strip() or "page"
    out_path = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, safe + ".pdf")

    ws_url = tab["webSocketDebuggerUrl"]
    print(f"Printing: {title}")
    print(f"  URL: {tab['url']}")
    print(f"  -> {out_path}")

    ws = websocket.create_connection(ws_url, timeout=120)
    msg_id = 0

    def send(method, params=None):
        global msg_id
        msg_id += 1
        ws.send(json.dumps({"id": msg_id, "method": method, "params": params or {}}))
        while True:
            resp = json.loads(ws.recv())
            if resp.get("id") == msg_id:
                return resp

    resp = send("Page.printToPDF", {
        "printBackground": True,
        "preferCSSPageSize": True,
    })
    ws.close()

    if "result" not in resp:
        print(f"  ERROR: {resp}")
        continue

    data = base64.b64decode(resp["result"]["data"])
    with open(out_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(data)
    print(f"  OK ({len(data)} bytes)")

print("Done.")
